Videos and Music: tap Allow access to read indexed media and show folders and file counts inside TN-Player. View & layout controls list/grid, sorting and filters. On Android 14 and newer, selected-video access shows only the videos Android grants. Tap Allow all media or use app permission settings to expand access.\n\nUse Add from storage in the menu to explicitly open a file or folder from an SD card, USB drive or document provider. In Files, tap a folder to enter or use its menu for copy, move, rename, share and delete. Copy/move supports individual files.

Folders contain accessible indexed media only. Android may omit .nomedia and protected locations. Use Add from storage → Open a folder for other provider storage.\n\nDate means last modified. Played time/status use this app's retained history (up to 200 items). Folder length/size are totals; date/played time use the newest member. Capture fps is Android's indexed capture rate, not a guaranteed encoded frame rate; unavailable values sort as zero.
Android could not request deletion. Try Add from storage → Open a folder for provider access.
